newsitem.title: USA: California Micro in tentative settlement.
newsitem.headline: California Micro in tentative settlement.

text.p: California Micro Devices Corp said on Monday it had reached a tentative settlement of class action lawsuits filed against it in 1994 and 1995.

It said the settlement calls for it to pay $6 million and issue 608,695 shares. Each share will be accompanied by a Contingent Value Right (CVR) guaranteeing that the stock will trade at an average price of at least $11.50 for 20 consecutive trading days within three years after issuance.
The company said the settlement releases it and its outside directors, other than former Chairman Chan Desaigoudar, from any further claims of liability.
The company gave no futher details on the suits or the settlement.
